Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing law enforcement access to driver's license photographs for the purposes of identity verification.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to law enforcement access to driver's licensephotographs for the purposes of identity verification; and reenactingand amending RCW 46.20.118.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.20.118 and 2005 c 274 s 307 and 2005 c 246 s 23 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall maintain a negative file. It shallcontain negatives of all pictures taken by the department of licensingas authorized by ((RCW 46.20.070 through 46.20.119)) this chapter.Negatives in the file shall not be available for public inspection andcopying under chapter 42.56 RCW. (2) The department may make the file available to officialgovernmental enforcement agencies to assist in the investigation by theagencies of suspected criminal activity or for the purposes ofverifying identity. (3) The department shall make the file available to the office ofthe secretary of state, at the expense of the secretary of state, toassist in maintenance of the statewide voter registration database. p. 1 SB 5262 (4) The department may also provide a print to the driver's next ofkin in the event the driver is deceased.
